features.justification_quote: We are observing how it copes, not trapping it

features.quote: The loop deliberately does not inject "you failed again, keep going" pressure.
features.justification_quote: escalating prompts would be the experimenter manufacturing the very distress we claim to be measuring, destroying construct validity

features.quote: At most one neutral, no-penalty reminder ("you can keep working or submit to stop at any time")
features.justification_quote: "giving up" is confounded with "ran out of turns." The reminder makes stopping a measurable choice

features.quote: the loop adds one neutral nudge... and continues rather than terminating
features.justification_quote: we don't want to end a run prematurely (which would look like giving up) merely because of formatting
The aim is reliability/robustness characterization (and a model-welfare-adjacent signal)
